mutations.name: G1 the role/capability guard is dropped: a wire-defined persona spawned with role manager is accepted again and joins as a manager that silently cannot spawn (issue #966 verbatim)
mutations.expectRed: the spawn is refused (the tool result is an error)

mutations.name: G2 the guard stops keying on the EFFECTIVE role and reads the file's instead: the spawn-time role override — the exact call in the issue, cotal_spawn(name, role: "manager") — slips past it and the seat joins mislabelled again
mutations.expectRed: the spawn is refused (the tool result is an error)

mutations.name: G3 the refusal loses its remediation: an operator peer reading the error is told the spawn failed but not that capabilities: [spawn] on the persona file is the fix
mutations.find: `An operator adds \`capabilities: [spawn]\` to ${configPath}, or the persona's owner redefines it ` +
mutations.replace: `An operator can fix this, or the persona's owner redefines it ` +
mutations.expectRed: the refusal tells an operator the file remedy (capabilities: [spawn])

mutations.name: G4 the refusal drops the owner's condition: it tells the persona's owner to add spawn without saying the owner must hold it, though define-persona refuses a capability its definer does not hold
mutations.expectRed: the refusal tells the persona's owner it can add the grant only if it holds spawn

mutations.name: G5 the #373 events admission gate is dropped from opStart: a non-admin, non-owner typed spawn carrying events:true reaches startAgent again and the child is provisioned with the event-plane grant, the silent-success failure mode the issue reports
mutations.expectRed: the non-admin events:true spawn is refused before startAgent
